mapper.select: SELECT e.id AS id, e.express_no AS expressNo, e.company_id AS companyId, c.company_name AS companyName, e.sender_name AS senderName, e.sender_phone AS senderPhone, e.receiver_name AS receiverName, e.receiver_phone AS receiverPhone, e.receiver_user_id AS receiverUserId, e.pickup_code AS pickupCode, e.location_id AS locationId, s.shelf_no AS shelfNo, l.location_no AS locationNo, e.status AS status, e.size_type AS sizeType, e.weight AS weight, DATE_FORMAT(e.arrival_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS arrivalTime, DATE_FORMAT(e.storage_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS storageTime, DATE_FORMAT(e.pickup_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS pickupTime, e.overdue_flag AS overdueFlag, e.remark AS remark, DATE_FORMAT(e.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime, DATE_FORMAT(e.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updateTime FROM express e LEFT JOIN express_company c ON c.id = e.company_id LEFT JOIN shelf_location l ON l.id = e.location_id LEFT JOIN shelf s ON s.id = l.shelf_id WHERE e.id = #{id} AND e.deleted = 0

SELECT e.id AS id, e.express_no AS expressNo, e.company_id AS companyId, c.company_name AS companyName, e.sender_name AS senderName, e.sender_phone AS senderPhone, e.receiver_name AS receiverName, e.receiver_phone AS receiverPhone, e.receiver_user_id AS receiverUserId, e.pickup_code AS pickupCode, e.location_id AS locationId, s.shelf_no AS shelfNo, l.location_no AS locationNo, e.status AS status, e.size_type AS sizeType, e.weight AS weight, DATE_FORMAT(e.arrival_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS arrivalTime, DATE_FORMAT(e.storage_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS storageTime, DATE_FORMAT(e.pickup_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS pickupTime, e.overdue_flag AS overdueFlag, e.remark AS remark, DATE_FORMAT(e.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime, DATE_FORMAT(e.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updateTime FROM express e LEFT JOIN express_company c ON c.id = e.company_id LEFT JOIN shelf_location l ON l.id = e.location_id LEFT JOIN shelf s ON s.id = l.shelf_id WHERE e.express_no = #{expressNo} AND e.deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO express ( express_no, company_id, sender_name, sender_phone, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_user_id, pickup_code, location_id, status, size_type, weight, arrival_time, storage_time, pickup_time, overdue_flag, remark, deleted, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{expressNo}, #{companyId}, #{senderName}, #{senderPhone}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{receiverUserId}, #{pickupCode}, #{locationId}, #{status}, #{sizeType}, #{weight}, #{arrivalTime}, #{storageTime}, #{pickupTime}, #{overdueFlag}, #{remark}, #{deleted}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.update: UPDATE express SET express_no = #{expressNo}, company_id = #{companyId}, sender_name = #{senderName}, sender_phone = #{senderPhone}, receiver_name = #{receiverName}, receiver_phone = #{receiverPhone}, receiver_user_id = #{receiverUserId}, size_type = #{sizeType}, weight = #{weight}, arrival_time = #{arrivalTime}, remark = #{remark}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT e.id AS id, e.express_no AS expressNo, e.company_id AS companyId, c.company_name AS companyName, e.sender_name AS senderName, e.sender_phone AS senderPhone, e.receiver_name AS receiverName, e.receiver_phone AS receiverPhone, e.receiver_user_id AS receiverUserId, e.pickup_code AS pickupCode, e.location_id AS locationId, s.shelf_no AS shelfNo, l.location_no AS locationNo, e.status AS status, e.size_type AS sizeType, e.weight AS weight, DATE_FORMAT(e.arrival_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS arrivalTime, DATE_FORMAT(e.storage_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS storageTime, DATE_FORMAT(e.pickup_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS pickupTime, e.overdue_flag AS overdueFlag, e.remark AS remark, DATE_FORMAT(e.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime, DATE_FORMAT(e.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updateTime FROM express e LEFT JOIN express_company c ON c.id = e.company_id LEFT JOIN shelf_location l ON l.id = e.location_id LEFT JOIN shelf s ON s.id = l.shelf_id WHERE e.pickup_code = #{pickupCode} AND e.deleted = 0

SELECT e.id AS id, e.express_no AS expressNo, e.company_id AS companyId, c.company_name AS companyName, e.sender_name AS senderName, e.sender_phone AS senderPhone, e.receiver_name AS receiverName, e.receiver_phone AS receiverPhone, e.receiver_user_id AS receiverUserId, e.pickup_code AS pickupCode, e.location_id AS locationId, s.shelf_no AS shelfNo, l.location_no AS locationNo, e.status AS status, e.size_type AS sizeType, e.weight AS weight, DATE_FORMAT(e.arrival_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS arrivalTime, DATE_FORMAT(e.storage_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS storageTime, DATE_FORMAT(e.pickup_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS pickupTime, e.overdue_flag AS overdueFlag, e.remark AS remark, DATE_FORMAT(e.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime, DATE_FORMAT(e.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updateTime FROM express e LEFT JOIN express_company c ON c.id = e.company_id LEFT JOIN shelf_location l ON l.id = e.location_id LEFT JOIN shelf s ON s.id = l.shelf_id WHERE e.deleted = 0 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM operation_log ol WHERE ol.user_id = #{userId} AND ol.module = '快递入库' AND ol.operation = '完成入库' AND ol.result = 'SUCCESS' AND (SUBSTRING(ol.description, 4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = e.express_no COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci OR SUBSTRING(ol.description, 4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = CAST(e.id AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci) )
AND ( e.express_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR e.receiver_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR e.receiver_phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND e.status = #{status}
ORDER BY e.id DESC

SELECT e.id AS id, e.express_no AS expressNo, e.receiver_user_id AS receiverUserId, e.receiver_name AS receiverName, e.receiver_phone AS receiverPhone, e.pickup_code AS pickupCode, DATE_FORMAT(e.storage_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS storageTime FROM express e WHERE e.deleted = 0 AND e.status = 'WAITING_PICKUP' AND e.overdue_flag = 0 AND e.storage_time IS NOT NULL AND e.storage_time < #{cutoff} ORDER BY e.id ASC

SELECT e.id AS id, e.express_no AS expressNo, e.receiver_name AS receiverName, e.receiver_phone AS receiverPhone, e.pickup_code AS pickupCode, e.location_id AS locationId, s.shelf_no AS shelfNo, l.location_no AS locationNo, DATE_FORMAT(e.storage_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS storageTime, e.overdue_flag AS overdueFlag, IFNULL(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, DATE_ADD(e.storage_time, INTERVAL #{hours} HOUR), NOW()), 0) AS overdueHours, e.remark AS remark FROM express e LEFT JOIN shelf_location l ON l.id = e.location_id LEFT JOIN shelf s ON s.id = l.shelf_id WHERE e.deleted = 0 AND e.status = 'WAITING_PICKUP' AND e.overdue_flag = 1 AND e.storage_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{hours} HOUR)
AND (e.express_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR e.receiver_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR e.receiver_phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY e.storage_time ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM express WHERE deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM express WHERE deleted = 0 AND DATE(storage_time) = CURDATE()
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM express WHERE deleted = 0 AND DATE(pickup_time) = CURDATE()
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM express WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 'WAITING_PICKUP'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM express WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 'WAITING_PICKUP' AND overdue_flag = 1

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(storage_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS inboundCount FROM express WHERE deleted = 0 AND storage_time IS NOT NULL AND DATE(storage_time) >= #{start} AND DATE(storage_time) <= #{end} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(storage_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(storage_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(pickup_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS pickupCount FROM express WHERE deleted = 0 AND pickup_time IS NOT NULL AND DATE(pickup_time) >= #{start} AND DATE(pickup_time) <= #{end} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(pickup_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(pickup_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ASC

SELECT HOUR(pickup_time) AS hour, COUNT(*) AS count FROM express WHERE deleted = 0 AND pickup_time IS NOT NULL AND DATE(pickup_time) >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY HOUR(pickup_time) ORDER BY hour ASC

SELECT DAYOFWEEK(pickup_time) AS weekday, HOUR(pickup_time) AS hour, COUNT(*) AS count FROM express WHERE deleted = 0 AND pickup_time IS NOT NULL AND DATE(pickup_time) >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DAYOFWEEK(pickup_time), HOUR(pickup_time) ORDER BY weekday ASC, hour ASC

SELECT DISTINCT e.location_id FROM express e INNER JOIN shelf_location l ON l.id = e.location_id WHERE e.deleted = 0 AND e.pickup_time IS NULL AND e.location_id IS NOT NULL
AND l.shelf_id = #{shelfId}
